manifest.author: kody-w
manifest.description: Connects any SKILL-aware claw directly to a local or hosted RAPP Brainstem over the one /chat wire, preserves sessions, installs and proves the canonical RAPP SDK Builder, hotloads reversible RAR skills into Scout and Copilot CLI, exports verified manual-loading guides for Scout, Copilot Cowork, and Copilot Studio, installs the optional self-bootstrapping Scout callback agent, bootstraps the global Brainstem, and supplies the pinned full RAPP/1 protocol.
manifest.name: @kody-w/rapp_skill_agent

agent.description: Canonical RAR identity or Scout skill name for install/remove.

allow_install.description: Authorize ensure to launch the checksum-pinned global Brainstem installer when no installation exists.

brainstem_secret.description: Optional X-Brainstem-Secret for non-loopback tiers. Never returned or logged.

brainstem_url.description: Brainstem base URL. Defaults to RAPP_BRAINSTEM_URL or http://localhost:7071.

catalog_url.description: RAR Scout catalog URL or local path. Defaults to the public RAR catalog.

channel.description: Skill channel for list/sync, such as starter, native, powercat, cowork-cookbook, rapplications, or all.

conversation_history.description: Optional live-kernel compatibility history. Strict rapp/1 servers may ignore it.

force.description: Allow install_sdk to back up and replace a differing existing SDK Builder, or bootstrap_callback to replace a differing callback agent.

idempotency_key.description: Optional rapp/1 retry key for de-duplicating a chat call.

include_full_spec.description: For protocol, fetch and return the complete pinned SPEC.md after SHA-256 verification.

install_sdk.description: For prove, install the pinned SDK if absent. Defaults to true.

launcher.description: Optional local Brainstem launcher path for ensure.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of list results.

operation.description: status=inspect Brainstem; ensure=start an existing or authorized fresh local install; chat=send work over POST /chat; install_sdk=hotload the pinned SDK Builder; bootstrap_callback=install the self-bootstrapping external-AI callback agent into a loopback Brainstem; prove=verify SDK parity and live Brainstem routing; protocol=return the RAPP/1 reference; list/install/sync/remove/verify=manage reversible RAR skills in the shared Copilot/Scout skill directory; manual_export=write a verified package and browser-readable loading guide.

output_dir.description: Destination directory for manual_export. Defaults to ~/Downloads/RAPP-Exports/<skill-name>.

platform.description: Platform to emphasize in manual_export. The HTML guide always includes all supported platforms.

session_id.description: Prior Brainstem session ID. Omit on the first turn.

skills_dir.description: Shared Scout/Copilot skills directory. Defaults to ~/.copilot/skills.
